incident: Menschen A2 L01 was falsely reported as Stage2B because PROJECT-STATE.json and central CHECKPOINT.json lagged behind workstream LATEST.json at Stage3C Batch0008.
authority_order: Explicit user-designated newer artifact in current chat; validate identity/integrity
Newest accessible validated portable workstream artifact/checkpoint in current chat, Project Sources or Library, based on actual milestone/lineage not filename or timestamp alone
Workstream-local LATEST.json if present, paired with its cited batch/milestone receipt and artifact identity/hash
Workstream CHECKPOINT.json, only if not contradicted by higher-priority evidence
Global PROJECT-STATE.json summary, only if not contradicted by higher-priority evidence
Historical branches and old reports for recovery/comparison only

startup_gate.derive_directory_from: PROJECT-STATE.json workstream.checkpoint path OR direct workstream path
startup_gate.stale_central_disposition: LABEL_STALE_AND_IGNORE_FOR_PROGRESS; do not downgrade to central status
startup_gate.absence_of_latest: fall back to verified portable, then CHECKPOINT/root summary; record missing pointer, do not invent
startup_gate.conflict_or_hash_mismatch: REPORT_CONFLICT_OR_BLOCKED; do not guess or certify PASS
startup_gate.reporting: Report latest *verified scope* (e.g. Stage3C Batch0008 PARTIAL), open dimensions, explicit blockers, next action, and distinguish Git-recorded tests from tests rerun now
startup_gate.no_forced_sync: Read/check via lightweight metadata; Git is an async durability mirror, not binary transport or production blocker
startup_gate.stage_acceptance: Do not promote bounded batch PASS into full Stage PASS, Stage4 or runtime FINAL

persistence_gate.after_each_validated_workstream_mileston: Persist portable checkpoint and independent QA; update milestone receipt and workstream LATEST.json; attempt bounded Git sync before handoff
persistence_gate.central_checkpoint: Update when safe; if stale keep explicit LATEST pointer authoritative and declare stale
persistence_gate.global_project_state: Refresh when safe; staleness must never hide newer workstream-local progress
persistence_gate.git_failure: Record PENDING/FAILED with exact hash and resume from newest valid portable artifact; no destructive fallback
persistence_gate.parallelism: Re-read the current LATEST SHA before pointer writes; never overwrite a concurrent newer milestone; preserve lesson/source/workstream isolation

known_example.note: Example paths only; do not pin Stage3C Batch0008 as a permanently current result

automation_boundary: Rules are enforced whenever a connected agent begins/resumes work and reads startup policy. This does not launch unattended periodic jobs or force other live chats to refresh automatically.

live_provider_discovery_20261115.purpose: Before reporting 'latest' after chat rollover, actually query current accessible providers, verify exact working master bytes and only then apply the already-integrated status-currentness gate.
live_provider_discovery_20261115.scope: Named source family status/resume in one user request; no global background crawl, forced 21-family audit or repeated per-card checks.
search_order: Use user's current conversation/Project references and any explicitly named artifact first.

Resolve the exact family id and canonical Library root from existing MASTER-PROJECT-CATALOG-v1.json; search Library scoped to that folder and descend Current, Drafts, Checkpoints and other real subfolders as necessary. A name-only global search may omit large or nested files.

Search connected Google Drive by short source tokens and the relevant known Drive folder; additionally follow an exact existing owner/receipt Drive file ID if a name-only search misses it. Verify the fetched ID/title; an empty general search does NOT prove absence.

Read latest source-owned Git LATEST, CHECKPOINT, RUN-CONTROL and referenced receipt only for the relevant workstream. Git snapshots and root summaries remain comparisons, never a substitute for actual newer working bytes.

Check available candidate lineage/stage and raw SHA-256 for the selected working master, then feed the existing Tools/status_currentness_gate_v1.py or Tools/build_project_control_center_v1.py --currentness-evidence-dir. Distinguish WORKING_CURRENT, ACCEPTED_BASELINE, GIT_SYNC.

provider_tools_when_available.library: files.search using scope.surfaces=['library'] and/or files.list with canonical library_path; browse nested folder or locate exact Library file ID before materializing selected bytes
provider_tools_when_available.drive: Google_Drive.search and Google_Drive.list_folder with verified exact folder URL; Google_Drive.fetch by verified exact file ID/URL for the selected candidate; raw bytes must be obtained for SHA when required
provider_tools_when_available.github: GitHub.fetch_file on exact named source-owned LATEST, CHECKPOINT and RUN-CONTROL; use blob SHA as metadata not master SHA-256

live_provider_discovery_20261115.evidence_boundary: A tool result is evidence of the files actually returned only. Never mark an unqueried provider 'checked'; unreturned files are not proven absent. Validated hash of one observed candidate means OBSERVED_CURRENT, not guaranteed globally newest.
live_provider_discovery_20261115.blocked_behavior: If provider unavailable, listing incomplete, selected source bytes unavailable, or candidates conflict, set CURRENT_NOT_VERIFIED/HOLD with the actual missing evidence. Do not silently report R10 as latest working because R16 or later cannot be accessed.
live_provider_discovery_20261115.output: Concise current working (observed), accepted baseline, source locator/proof, true blocker and next action; no repetitive Stage6, no ZIP, no retroactive promotion.

real_pilot_20261115.lesson: Generic Drive title search missed exact R16-P19 master; exact verified Drive file ID from prior receipt resolved file
real_pilot_20261115.accepted_baseline_reference: R10 historical receipt; not a claim of latest working
real_pilot_20261115.qualifier: As-of 2026-11-15 observed source only. No proof that no later file exists. Source card content unchanged.
